title: Lapse Days Added Back on a Reinstated Homesite Reservation Hold
content:
**Clause.** On the reinstatement of an expired Homesite Reservation hold, the lapse days are the calendar days from the date the hold expired (the end date on the expired reservation) to the reinstatement date. The lapse add-back is judged by the courtesy expiry reminders on the reservation ledger, the notice entries with notice type expiry reminder: where no expiry reminder was sent, every lapse day is added back; where the latest expiry reminder was sent fewer than the class's expiry reminder days before the hold expiry date, half of the lapse days are added back, rounded up to a whole day; where it was sent the class's expiry reminder days or more before the hold expiry date, nothing is added back, and the reinstated hold counts only from the reinstatement date.

## Class expiry reminder days

| Premium class | Expiry reminder days before the hold expiry date |
|---|---|
| Interior Homesite | 3 |
| Corner Homesite | 3 |
| Cul-de-Sac Homesite | 3 |
| Greenbelt Homesite | 2 |
| Water-View Homesite | 2 |
| Golf-Frontage Homesite | 2 |

## Cases (hypothetical Greenbelt Homesite, hold expiry date 20 May, hold expired 21 May, reinstated 24 May: 3 lapse days)

| Expiry reminders on the ledger | Lead before the hold expiry date | Days added back |
|---|---|---|
| none | | 3 |
| latest sent 19 May | 1 day, fewer than 2 | half of 3, rounded up: 2 |
| latest sent 18 May | 2 days, not fewer than 2 | none |
